name: General Graardor

mechanics.name: Melee Punch
mechanics.description: A heavy fist thrown at whoever he is currently on. It is what he reaches for on roughly two of every three attacks.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Protect from Melee while he is targeting you.

mechanics.name: Shockwave Slam
mechanics.description: He hammers the floor and a shockwave rolls out to every player in the chamber, not only his target. It is a Ranged attack, but he can only throw it from melee range.
mechanics.counterplay: Everyone off the tank prays Protect from Missiles. Do not rely on standing back to dodge it.

mechanics.name: Sergeant Steelwill
mechanics.description: The magic bodyguard. He throws yellow blasts from anywhere in the room at whoever last damaged Graardor.
mechanics.counterplay: Kill him first, before either of the other two. Swap to Protect from Magic once Graardor is down.

mechanics.name: Sergeant Grimspike
mechanics.description: The ranged bodyguard. He lobs hand axes across the chamber, so backing away from him buys nothing.
mechanics.counterplay: Kill him second, straight after Steelwill. Protect from Missiles covers him.

mechanics.name: Sergeant Strongstack
mechanics.description: The melee bodyguard. He chases whoever last damaged Graardor and beats on them with a flail.
mechanics.counterplay: Kill him last, he hits the softest of the three. The Protect from Melee you are already holding covers him.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Every id below was read out of Jagex's own gameval names rather than guessed, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight yet, which issue #12 requires before this boss is done. Provenance: gamevals came from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24), so the cachetool's ScanGameVal cannot read them; model, sequence and extent data came from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Npc ids: GODWARS_BANDOS_AVATAR 2215 (the God Wars Dungeon fight), CLANCUP_GODWARS_BANDOS_AVATAR 6494 and DEADMAN_BREACH_GODWARS_BANDOS 12444 (event variants of the same boss, which fight alone with no bodyguards), plus the three bodyguards GODWARS_SERGEANT_GOBLIN1 2216 (Strongstack), GOBLIN2 2217 (Steelwill), GOBLIN3 2218 (Grimspike). The bodyguards are deliberately IN npcIds, which is the call issue #12 left to this PR: unlike Abyssal Sire's spawns, they are fixed, named, always-present occupants of the chamber rather than summoned adds, and detection only reaches an npc's animations and projectiles when that npc is tracked (DetectionEngine.animationPlayed/projectileFired), so leaving them out would have forced all three to detect on npc-spawn and unlock the instant you walk through the door. BANDOS_PET 6632 and POH_BANDOS_PET 6644 are excluded as pets. Animations: GODWARS_BANDOS_ATTACK 7018 and GODWARS_BANDOS_ATTACK_LOOP 8765 (same 14 frames / 42 cycles, frameStep 14, i.e. the looping form of the same punch), GODWARS_BANDOS_RANGED 7021. The bodyguards reuse the Land of the Goblins sergeant animation set: SLICE_SURFACE_GOBLIN_SERGENT_ATTACK 6154 for Strongstack, with GODWARS_SERGEANT_GOBLIN2_SONIC 7071 and GODWARS_SERGEANT_GOBLIN3_RANGED 7073 for the two ranged bodyguards. 6154 being a shared quest animation is safe: an animation trigger only matches an npc the engine is tracking as this boss, so a goblin sergeant playing it in Dorgesh-Kaan never fires. Projectiles: GODWARS_BANDOS_PROJ 1202, GODWARS_GOBLIN2_SONIC_ATTK_PROJ 1217, GODWARS_GOBLIN3_HANDAXE_PROJ 1220 (spotanims 1215 and 1219 carry the sergeants' own body models rather than a missile and are not used). Graphic 1203 GODWARS_BANDOS_SPOT is the slam impact; it is safe under the SCHEMA.md actor-attribution rule because a player cannot produce it and it only exists inside Graardor's chamber. Zoom and shiftY are FitZoom output at the 291x140 box with the standard 10% margin, shiftY already projected to pixels at the zoom shipped here. The collection log page is titled 'General Graardor', matching 'name'. THE TWO GRAARDOR PREVIEWS ARE A DELIBERATE OVERLAY, NOT A SIDE-BY-SIDE. Npc 2215 carries two models (27665, the ork body, and 27660, the armour over it) and the preview widget renders a single cache model id, so a plain npcId preview showed only models[0] and Graardor came out missing his head, arms and legs. The fix is data-only: primary is modelId 27665, secondary is modelId 27660 at the SAME zoom, shiftX 0 and shiftY, so the two widgets occupy the same rect and the two halves composite into one figure. The armour is the secondary because the secondary slot draws second, i.e. on top, which is where armour belongs. SCHEMA.md describes secondary as 'a second model shown beside this one'; identical shifts is what turns beside into on top of. Zoom and shiftY here are fitted across the UNION of both models' animated extents (melee 7018: X[-242..331] Y[-561..157]; slam 7021: X[-351..337] Y[-652..122]), not either model alone, so neither half clips. The bodyguards are also multi-model npcs and are deliberately left on the plain models[0] path, since they read correctly as they are.
_followups: 1. Live verification of every id above per issue #12's acceptance criteria, with Log boss trigger ids on. 2. If a bodyguard's attack animation turns out not to fire, its npc-spawn id (2216 / 2217 / 2218) is the fallback trigger, at the cost of unlocking on room entry rather than on the attack. 3. GODWARS_BANDOS_DEFEND 7019 and GODWARS_BANDOS_DEATH 7020 exist but are not mechanics. 4. staticFallback is false on all five; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game. 5. FitZoom fits models[0] only, so Graardor's second model (27665) and the bodyguards' secondary models are not in the extents.
